task.title: Entitlement not proven — Claim in MPS

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the D61 decision as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “The client is not providing care or support — D61 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”

Details: Type “The client [is or was] out of Canada for the period of [date of absence]. Client is receiving family caregiver benefits. There is no proof that the client [continues or continued] to provide care or support to the patient while outside of Canada, as [provide all details supporting this statement].”

step.cmd: Create a ROD for the D13 decision as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Out of Canada — D13 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
If it is a continuing claim, go to step 4.
If it is an initial or renewal claim, go to step 9.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the out of Canada issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 5.

If no , select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction to advise IPOC to stop payment as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
BPC: Select the BPC of the appropriate claim.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work Type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .

Remarks line 1: Select the appropriate option:
If the end date is known, type “D61 and D13 from w/c [XXXX-X] to w/c [XXXX-X].”
If the end date is not known, type “D61 and D13 from w/c [XXXX-X] to 9999-9.”
Remarks line 2: Type “The client is not entitled to collect benefits for the out of Canada period.”
Remarks line 3: Type your name and telephone number.
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Click Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Special benefits denied (3065): Select Family caregiver benefits denied: D61, D62, D63 (4315) .
Select D61 - Not entitled to family caregiver - Various reasons (4316) .
Select D61 - Claimant does not provide care or support to the critically ill or injured family member .
Select Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485) .
Overpayment messages (2452) .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .

This letter replaces or Footnote (2365): Select Footnote and type “We are unable to pay you family caregiver benefits from [date] because you have not proven that you [are or were] providing care or support to your family member while you [are or were] out of Canada.”
Go to step 11.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Special benefits denied (3065): Select Family caregiver benefits denied: D61, D62, D63 (4315) .
Select D61 - Not entitled to family caregiver - Various reasons (4316) .
Select D61 - Claimant does not provide care or support to the critically ill or injured family member .
Select Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485) .
Overpayment messages (2452) .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .

This letter replaces or Footnote (2365): Select Footnote and type “We are unable to pay you family caregiver benefits from [date] because you have not proven that you [are or were] providing care or support to your family member while you [are or were] out of Canada.”

step.cmd: In NWS, create a client Note and type “Submit MM06 to enter the M161 inputs. D61 and D13 from [XXXX-X] to w/c [XXXX-X]. Send the saved N-00-00-00 letter.”
In NWS, complete the WI for the out of Canada issue.
